\newpage

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: tbl-one
#| tbl-cap: Posterior medians and 95% credible intervals from a multivariate Bayesian mixed model predicting egg size (Gaussian) and egg number (Poisson) as a function of clutch (Brood 2 relative to Brood 1), with random intercepts for female ID (here and elsewhere clutch is synonomous with brood).

# -----------------------------
# 1. FIXED EFFECTS (Mean model)
# -----------------------------

fixed_tab <- m_mv_2 |>
  spread_draws(
    b_meaneggsize_Intercept,
    b_meaneggsize_broodtwo,
    b_eggnumber_Intercept,
    b_eggnumber_broodtwo
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
               names_to = "term",
               values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      b_meaneggsize_Intercept = "Egg size: Intercept (Brood 1)",
      b_meaneggsize_broodtwo = "Egg size: Brood 2 − Brood 1",
      b_eggnumber_Intercept = "Egg number: Intercept (Brood 1)",
      b_eggnumber_broodtwo = "Egg number: Brood 2 − Brood 1"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 2. RANDOM INTERCEPTS (ID level)
# -----------------------------

random_tab <- m_mv_2 |>
  spread_draws(
    sd_id__meaneggsize_Intercept,
    sd_id__eggnumber_Intercept
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
               names_to = "term",
               values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      sd_id__meaneggsize_Intercept = "SD (Egg size | Female ID)",
      sd_id__eggnumber_Intercept = "SD (Egg number | Female ID)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 3. RESIDUAL SD (Gaussian only)
# -----------------------------

sigma_tab <- m_mv_2 |>
  spread_draws(sigma_meaneggsize) |>
  median_qi(sigma_meaneggsize, .width = 0.95) |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = "Residual SD (Egg size)",
    Estimate = round(sigma_meaneggsize, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 4. COMBINE
# -----------------------------

final_tab <- bind_rows(
  fixed_tab,
  random_tab,
  sigma_tab
)

flextable(final_tab) |>
  autofit()
```

\newpage

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: FALSE
#| label: tbl-two
#| tbl-cap: Posterior medians and 95% credible intervals from a multivariate Gaussian mixed model jointly estimating egg size and egg number. The model includes random intercepts for female ID and estimates residual correlation between traits.

# -----------------------------
# 1. FIXED EFFECTS (INTERCEPTS)
# -----------------------------

fixed_tab <- m_mv |>
  spread_draws(
    b_meaneggsize_Intercept,
    b_eggnumber_Intercept
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
               names_to = "term",
               values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      b_meaneggsize_Intercept = "Egg size: Intercept",
      b_eggnumber_Intercept = "Egg number: Intercept"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 2. RANDOM INTERCEPT SDs
# -----------------------------

random_tab <- m_mv |>
  spread_draws(
    sd_id__meaneggsize_Intercept,
    sd_id__eggnumber_Intercept
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
               names_to = "term",
               values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      sd_id__meaneggsize_Intercept = "SD (Egg size | Female ID)",
      sd_id__eggnumber_Intercept = "SD (Egg number | Female ID)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 3. RESIDUAL STRUCTURE
# -----------------------------

resid_tab <- m_mv |>
  spread_draws(
    sigma_meaneggsize,
    sigma_eggnumber,
    rescor__meaneggsize__eggnumber
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
               names_to = "term",
               values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      sigma_meaneggsize = "Residual SD (Egg size)",
      sigma_eggnumber = "Residual SD (Egg number)",
      rescor_meaneggsize_eggnumber =
        "Residual correlation (Egg size, Egg number)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 4. COMBINE
# -----------------------------

final_tab <- bind_rows(
  fixed_tab,
  random_tab,
  resid_tab
)

flextable(final_tab) |>
  autofit()
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: FALSE
#| label: tbl-three
#| tbl-cap: Posterior medians and 95% credible intervals from a Bayesian mixed model predicting mean egg size. The model included within- and between-female egg number effects, a random intercept for female ID, and Gaussian residual variance.

# -----------------------------
# 1. FIXED EFFECTS
# -----------------------------

fixed_tab <- fit.null |>
  spread_draws(b_Intercept,
               b_egg_number_within,
               b_egg_number_between) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
               names_to = "term",
               values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      b_Intercept = "Intercept",
      b_egg_number_within = "Egg number (within female)",
      b_egg_number_between = "Egg number (between female)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 2. RANDOM INTERCEPT
# -----------------------------

random_tab <- fit.null |>
  spread_draws(sd_id__Intercept) |>
  median_qi(sd_id__Intercept, .width = 0.95) |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = "SD (Intercept | Female ID)",
    Estimate = round(sd_id__Intercept, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 3. RESIDUAL VARIANCE
# -----------------------------

sigma_tab <- fit.null |>
  spread_draws(sigma) |>
  median_qi(sigma, .width = 0.95) |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = "Residual SD (sigma)",
    Estimate = round(sigma, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 4. COMBINE EVERYTHING
# -----------------------------

final_tab <- bind_rows(
  fixed_tab,
  random_tab,
  sigma_tab
)

final_ft <- flextable(final_tab) |>
  set_caption("Table S1. Posterior medians and 95% credible intervals from a Bayesian mixed model predicting mean egg size. The model included within- and between-female egg number effects, a random intercept for female ID, and Gaussian residual variance.") |>
  autofit()

final_ft
```

    names_to = "term",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  group_by(term) |>

  ungroup() |>

      b_Intercept = "Intercept (Brood 1)",

      b_egg_number_between = "Egg number (between female)",
      b_broodtwo = "Brood 2 − Brood 1"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),

    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>

  spread_draws(sigma) |>
  select(-.chain, -.iteration, -.draw) |>
  median_qi(sigma, .width = 0.95) |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = "Residual SD (sigma)",
    Estimate = round(sigma, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 4. COMBINE INTO ONE TABLE
# -----------------------------

final_tab <- bind_rows(
  fixed_tab,

  sigma_tab

flextable(final_tab) |>

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: FALSE
#| label: tbl-six
#| tbl-cap: Posterior medians and 95% credible intervals from a Bayesian mixed model of scaled egg perimeter, including clutch-specific means, clutch-specific female-level random effects, and clutch-specific residual variance.

# -----------------------------
# 1. FIXED EFFECTS (Mean model)
# -----------------------------

fixed_tab <- egg.size.model.alt |>
  spread_draws(
    b_Intercept,
    b_brood_factortwo
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
    names_to = "term",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      b_Intercept = "Mean (Brood 1)",
      b_brood_factortwo = "Brood 2 − Brood 1"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 2. RANDOM EFFECTS (ID level)
# -----------------------------

random_tab <- egg.size.model.alt |>
  spread_draws(
    sd_id__brood_factorone,
    sd_id__brood_factortwo,
    cor_id__brood_factorone__brood_factortwo
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
    names_to = "term",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      sd_id__brood_factorone = "SD (Brood 1 | Female ID)",
      sd_id__brood_factortwo = "SD (Brood 2 | Female ID)",
      cor_id__brood_factorone__brood_factortwo =
        "Correlation (Brood 1, Brood 2 | Female ID)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 3. RESIDUAL SD (back-transformed)
# -----------------------------

sigma_tab <- egg.size.model.alt |>
  spread_draws(
    b_sigma_Intercept,
    b_sigma_brood_factortwo
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sigma_brood1 = exp(b_sigma_Intercept),
    sigma_brood2 = exp(b_sigma_Intercept + b_sigma_brood_factortwo)
  ) |>
  select(-.chain, -.iteration, -.draw) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sigma_brood1, sigma_brood2),
    names_to = "term",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      sigma_brood1 = "Residual SD (Brood 1)",
      sigma_brood2 = "Residual SD (Brood 2)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 4. COMBINE
# -----------------------------

final_tab <- bind_rows(
  fixed_tab,
  random_tab,
  sigma_tab
)

flextable(final_tab) |>
  autofit()
```
